## Question

State the question clearly.

## Context

Describe your application, model pathway, relevant configuration, and what you
have already tried.

## Scientific interpretation

If the question concerns interpretation, identify the output variable, spatial
and temporal scale, and comparison or observation being considered.

## Additional information

Include a minimal example or references when helpful. Do not post confidential
data or credentials.
